productConcept.name: Griting
productConcept.description: Talent Trust and Readiness Infrastructure for the AI Capital — the infrastructure layer beneath AI talent platforms, providing verifiable capability assessment, talent development, and trusted human capital systems via GritMe Talent, GritMe Incubation, GritMe Mentorship, GritLab, and GritHub.
productConcept.rationale: Content-driven — all copy verbatim from griting source design system. Griting is the dominant brand; formless contributes structural patterns (sticky-scroll panels, 244px editorial margins, dual brand lockup, ambient radial glow, ghost→fill hover, opacity-0.6 nav links).

animationDecision: motion-tokens — griting-formless motion system contains formlessMotion block with cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) universal easing, scroll patterns (sticky-scroll-services), and explicit GSAP rules (transform-only, never opacity:0 in from()). Motion system has substance → always animate.
runNotes: Run 1 failed (GSAP opacity:0 blank sections, missing pages). Run 2 succeeded (CSS-only assets). Run 3: transform-only GSAP confirmed, all 6 pages generated, content audit passed (7 issues fixed), Higgsfield assets requested.
